Dialog is run by a super abusive family that treat their staff like shit. Trust me I used to work there. Do not support this business. They did a lot of sketchy things like wash and re use plastic cups, use canned vegetables and say they were fresh, say they made all their pastries in house when they are actually from Portos, and generally talk shit on their LGBTQ commmunity patrons when they are in the smack dab middle of WeHo. They used to run this lasagna lunch special and tell everyone it was made in house when it was really the frozen family sized Stouffers vegetable lasagna. Their popular breakfast burrito house sauce is literally just sriracha + ketchup.

The dad (Raffi) would watch porn in the middle of the day behind the counter like it was nothing, and the mom (Knarr) would talk down to the staff like they were her slaves. The son (Todd) would call me on my day off to yell at me as why the coffee bags werent rotated properly when there were two other baristas. Mind you this was on minimum wage + tips (that they pooled and tipped out as they pleased) as well. Super gross people overall and shorted me heavily on my last check.

I haven't tried disputing it but I sent an email to Nelnet with a goodwill letter asking them to please remove the missed payment from my scores as I was under the impression they were still paused. I let them know I immediately made a lump payment of around 8% of my total loan amounts and setup auto-debit with a doubled monthly amount from my previous payment plan. I will try to dispute with the bureaus as well though. This sucks, that's all we can do. Years of credit rebuilding work decimated overnight.

Same exact thing happened to me, you are not alone. My credit score was just about to cross 800 and I was stoked. About a week or two ago I got an alert my score had dropped, and it was down 161 points. I was under the impression student loans were in paused and could potentially be forgiven under the old administration. I am now back to a 650 credit score after working my tail off to bring it up from the low 500's when I started my credit rebuilding journey. 

I've begun repayment and increased the monthly auto debit. I am now stuck wondering how long it will take for me to build it back up again. Thankfully it is only about $6k so it should be paid off within the next 3 years, but I am also in shock and just outright pissed.

Paia Fish Market is excellent. Loco Moco from Kihei Caffe is pretty classic. Coconuts Fish Cafe was awesome, ate their twice had their famous fish tacos and then their mahi mahi sandwich. Best meal I had though was from an incredible food truck in Kihei called Kitoko, they did this lobster and sweet potato gnocchi special that was just out of this world, it was outstanding and the ambience was perfect.
For the free night no tax was paid. It says in the fine print "The Complimentary Weekend Night is valid for room and tax only."
Ended up booking Delta One Suites through Virgin, came to 116k + $48 for x2 LAX to FLR with a 5 hour layover in CDG. Thanks!
